scenario.title: Lab safety training
scenario.intro: You are attending a safety training session before you can use the chemistry teaching lab. The instructor is explaining the lab rules. Listen and repeat what the instructor says.

sentences: Always wear your safety glasses here.
Food and drinks are not allowed in here.
Please tie back long hair before you start any experiment.
If you spill anything, tell me right away instead of cleaning it yourself.
The emergency exits are marked in green, and there is a map beside each door.
Before you leave each session, check that the gas taps are closed and that your bench is clean for the next group.
